419:t_1:87.en:
$n
「No, I don't. ...Your cheerfulness helps me, $$ティティ$$, and I'm grateful for it.」

419:t_1:88.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So you still... can't forget that Miss $$スズネ$$?」

419:t_1:89.en:
$n
「Forget her? Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't dead. I'll rescue her, no matter what.」

419:t_1:92.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Listen, $n... If I die, send me off into space...」

419:t_1:93.en:
$n
「Why are you saying that all of a sudden...!?」

419:t_1:94.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It isn't sudden, is it? It makes sense in times like these.」

419:t_1:95.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... always think about what happens after I die.」

419:t_1:97.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Promise me, $n. You turned me down, so at least grant me that little request.」

419:t_1:99.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh... I don't need you to comfort me. I only said that about being your girlfriend on a whim. I wasn't serious at all.」

419:t_1:100.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Keep trying, $n. I'm rooting for you to get Miss $$スズネ$$ back.」

419:t_1:102.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... have to get dinner ready... See you.」

419:t_1:109.en:
$$ランド$$
「We've been together a pretty long time now...」

419:t_1:110.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ever since the Boss disappeared, you, $$メール$$, and I have charged ahead together. But I still don't seem to understand you...」

419:t_1:111.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Lend me your strength, $$ガンレオン$$.」

419:t_1:114.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「He's got something on his mind. He says he hasn't drawn out $$ガンレオン$$'s true power.」

419:t_1:115.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Even with all that!? $$ガンレオン$$ is already so strong...!」

419:t_1:116.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I don't really get it either, but $$ランド$$ says it should have way, way more power.」

419:t_1:117.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So basically, he hasn't drawn out the $$スフィア$$'s power.」

419:t_1:118.en:
$$エイミー$$
「The $$スフィア$$... That's what $$ガンレオン$$ and $$ジェニオン$$ have, right...?」

419:t_1:119.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hmm... Maybe encountering such a great power has made him shrink back...」

419:t_1:123.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Come on... Don't be so wary.」

419:t_1:124.en:
$$イアン$$
「We've gathered to lend a promising young man a hand.」

419:t_1:125.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Now that we're here, you're on board a safe ship... the $$ガルガンティア$$, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:127.en:
$$サックス$$
「You're fighting as $$チェインバー#robot$$'s pilot now, but you intend to return to the fleet someday, right?」

419:t_1:129.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We figured we'd teach you a trade for when that time comes.」

419:t_1:130.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm calling it Operation 'Teach $$レド$$ a Trade'!」

419:t_1:131.en:
$$レド$$
「You're overwhelming me! And that operation name is far too literal!」

419:t_1:132.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Don't say that! $$ランド$$ and everyone are looking out for you, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:134.en:
$$ランド$$
「You bet! So the $c maintenance crew's gonna drill the ABCs of machinery into you!」

419:t_1:135.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「We did want someone to do the grunt work too.」

419:t_1:136.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You didn't have to say that, $$タクヤ$$!」

419:t_1:137.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「What are you talking about!? You were the one happy to finally have someone below you, $$ピニオン$$!」

419:t_1:139.en:
$$サックス$$
「Come on, it's fine. Maintenance and housekeeping are always short of people.」

419:t_1:140.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Exactly. Mechanics should move their hands more than their mouths. Let's do today's maintenance.」

419:t_1:141.en:
$$イアン$$
「That's right. We'll need your help, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:143.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「No, no. This isn't the combat unit.」

419:t_1:144.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「All right! We'll show you how it's done!」

419:t_1:145.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Then, $$タクヤ$$, check the mobile suits. $$ピニオン$$, check the $$ＡＴ$$s, please.」

419:t_1:147.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I will do it, boss!」

419:t_1:148.en:
$$イアン$$
「Well, that's how we do it.」

419:t_1:149.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's get going, $$レド$$. You'll help everyone out.」

419:t_1:154.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Old guys sure love looking after the youngsters.」

419:t_1:155.en:
$$マリ$$
「You're one to talk, Princess. For all your complaints, you... care about Puppy too.」

419:t_1:157.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... Love and hate that have built up over a long, long time aren't easy to sort out...」

419:t_1:162.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$アスカ$$... I'd heard about you before we joined up... They said our personalities overlapped a little.」

419:t_1:163.en:
$$チコ$$
「But when I actually met you, it was different... You're more mature than I expected.」

419:t_1:166.en:
$$マリ$$
「You sound so self-mocking... I'll say it straight: you refuse to grow up.」

419:t_1:168.en:
$$マリ$$
「But you can't stay a boy forever... It looks like that gap will hurt you.」
